package domain_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	testCourseID  = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	testSectionID = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	testLessonID  = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	testRevision  = "2026-08-31T12:00:00Z"
)

func TestVerifyLessonContextBuildsModeSpecificBoundedProjection(t *testing.T) {
	content := validCourseLessonContent()
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		source *domain.LessonMessageContext
		assert func(*testing.T, domain.LessonTeachingContext)
	}{
		{
			name:   "selection",
			source: currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeSelection, "errors.Is(err, target)"),
			assert: func(t *testing.T, got domain.LessonTeachingContext) {
				require.Equal(t, "errors.Is(err, target)", got.SelectedText)
				require.Empty(t, got.Title)
				require.Empty(t, got.Excerpt)
			},
		},
		{
			name:   "overview",
			source: currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, ""),
			assert: func(t *testing.T, got domain.LessonTeachingContext) {
				require.Equal(t, content.Title, got.Title)
				require.Equal(t, content.Excerpt, got.Excerpt)
				require.Empty(t, got.SelectedText)
				require.Equal(t, testSectionID, got.SectionID)
			},
		},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			verified, err := domain.VerifyLessonContext(testLessonID, tt.source, content)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, verified.Schema)
			require.Equal(t, tt.source.Mode, verified.Mode)
			require.Equal(t, testCourseID, verified.CourseID)
			require.Equal(t, testLessonID, verified.LessonID)
			require.Equal(t, testRevision, verified.ContentRevision)
			tt.assert(t, verified)
		})
	}
}

func TestVerifyLessonContextFailsClosedOnIdentityRevisionAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		source  func() *domain.LessonMessageContext
		content func() domain.CourseLessonContent
	}{
		{
			name: "legacy source",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return &domain.LessonMessageContext{ContentRevision: testRevision, SelectedText: "errors.Is(err, target)"}
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "unknown schema",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				value := currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "")
				value.Schema = "lesson-message-context.v2"
				return value
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "unknown mode",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageMode("other"), "")
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "course mismatch",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "")
			},
			content: func() domain.CourseLessonContent {
				value := validCourseLessonContent()
				value.CourseID = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
				return value
			},
		},
		{
			name: "lesson mismatch",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				value := currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "")
				value.LessonID = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
				return value
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "stale revision",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				value := currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "")
				value.ContentRevision = "2026-08-31T12:01:00Z"
				return value
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "overview with selection",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "unexpected")
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "selection not in canonical content",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeSelection, "not canonical")
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "selection oversized",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeSelection, strings.Repeat("я", domain.MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes+1))
			},
			content: validCourseLessonContent,
		},
		{
			name: "overview title oversized",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "")
			},
			content: func() domain.CourseLessonContent {
				value := validCourseLessonContent()
				value.Title = strings.Repeat("я", domain.MaximumLessonOverviewTitleRunes+1)
				return value
			},
		},
		{
			name: "overview excerpt oversized",
			source: func() *domain.LessonMessageContext {
				return currentLessonSource(domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, "")
			},
			content: func() domain.CourseLessonContent {
				value := validCourseLessonContent()
				value.Excerpt = strings.Repeat("я", domain.MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes+1)
				return value
			},
		},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := domain.VerifyLessonContext(testLessonID, tt.source(), tt.content())
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
		})
	}
}

func validCourseLessonContent() domain.CourseLessonContent {
	return domain.CourseLessonContent{
		LessonID: testLessonID, CourseID: testCourseID, SectionID: testSectionID,
		Language: "ru", Title: "Ошибки", Excerpt: "Проверка ошибок",
		Description:     "Используйте errors.Is(err, target), чтобы проверить цепочку.",
		ContentRevision: testRevision,
	}
}

func currentLessonSource(mode domain.LessonMessageMode, selectedText string) *domain.LessonMessageContext {
	return &domain.LessonMessageContext{
		Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: mode,
		CourseID: testCourseID, LessonID: testLessonID,
		ContentRevision: testRevision, SelectedText: selectedText,
	}
}

func TestT14NormalizeFrozenUUIDLessonSource(t *testing.T) {
	var source domain.LessonMessageContext
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"schema":"lesson-message-context.v2","mode":"lesson_overview","course_id":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa","lesson_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","content_revision":"cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc","learning_path_id":"dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd","learning_path_item_id":"eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee","content_digest":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}`), &source))
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(&source)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, source.ContentRevision, normalized.ContentRevision)
}
